description: This file defines a React functional component named HistoryListContainer that manages the display of different history list views (Remote, Session, Legacy). It includes UI logic such as tab switching and rendering different sub-components based on the current tab. It also uses external modules like React, MobX, and project-specific components/controllers.

classes.name: Props
classes.description: Type definition for the component properties, including features, noteHistoryController, and selectMobileModalTab.
classes.TabButton: Inline functional component for rendering tab buttons with selection state.

methods.name: HistoryListContainer
methods.description: React functional component that renders a tabbed history list interface, switching between Remote, Session, and Legacy history views based on the current tab.

methods.name: CurrentTabList
methods.description: Inline component that returns the appropriate history list component based on the current tab.
